plugins.descriptionZh: 后台操控浏览器和 macOS，不抢鼠标键盘，让 AI 安静地帮你完成电脑操作。

plugins.name: dsh-tabbit
plugins.description: Drive the user's Tabbit Browser from DSH via its Browser-owned, task-isolated Playwright CLI (`tabbit-cli`): bundled `tabbit-browser` skill, ≥1.9.0 runtime preflight, region-aware installer download, and persistent named task spaces (no Chrome/Ego/CDP fallback).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 Tabbit 浏览器，通过 Playwright 自动化完成网页操作与任务执行。

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.description: Chrome sidebar extension.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 Chrome 装上侧边栏，让 DeepSeek 助手随时待命，边看网页边指挥它干活。

plugins.name: sheep-programmer/dsh-web-search-free
plugins.description: Free web search for DSH: anonymous Parallel default plus Exa fallback, a Settings toggle, and an MCP server compatible with Claude Code and Codex.
plugins.descriptionZh: 免费匿名网页搜索插件，支持并行搜索与Exa备用，可切换开关，还兼容Claude Code和Codex的MCP服务。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-browser-use
plugins.description: Browser Use cloud bridge: run real web tasks (open pages, click, type, fill forms, extract data) through the Browser Use API.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 Browser Use 云服务真实操作网页，自动完成点击、输入、填表、抓取数据等任务。

plugins.name: dsh-dispatch
plugins.description: Phone-side command center (plugin + zero-knowledge relay + PWA): dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from your phone, approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins (never auto-approved), and a multi-machine session board; E2E encrypted, self-hostable.
plugins.descriptionZh: 手机远程给 DeepSeek Harness 派任务、审批工具调用，锁屏一键批准，支持端到端加密和自托管。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-vision
plugins.description: Vision analysis tool: analyze a local image or URL with an OpenAI-compatible vision model.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上眼睛，直接分析本地图片或网络图片，用视觉模型回答你的问题。

plugins.name: dsh-antigravity
plugins.description: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider for DSH with native Web OAuth, real-time quota tracking, and dynamic reasoning effort routing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 接入 Google Antigravity 模型，支持网页授权登录、实时配额查看和智能推理强度路由。

plugins.name: dsh-webbridge
plugins.description: Web bridge.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让模型通过 Kimi WebBridge 操控你的真实浏览器，实现导航、点击、填表、截图等自动化操作。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/model-catalog
plugins.description: Model catalog auto-discovery: fetch model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalized into ready-to-use config.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动发现 OpenAI 兼容接口的模型列表、价格和能力，一键生成可直接使用的配置。

plugins.name: SeerableOfficial/dsh-web-search-toggle
plugins.description: Per-session Web Search toggle that directs the agent to search the web before answering.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在聊天输入框加一个网页搜索开关，开启后智能体会先搜网再回答，信息更准更及时。

plugins.name: dsh-agy-link
plugins.description: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) model provider for DSH: stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Google Antigravity 模型接入 DSH，支持流式对话、思考过程、工具调用和用量统计，还能在界面里直接登录 Google 账号。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agy-link@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org

plugins.name: dsh-browser-vision
plugins.description: Vision browser tool: drives real Chrome over CDP with browser-use and reads the page with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, so canvas text, text baked into images and values in rendered charts are readable; returns JSON validated against a caller-supplied schema and reports per-run token cost.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让浏览器工具能看懂网页内容，直接读取截图、图表和图片里的文字，无需额外解析。

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen
plugins.description: Native image generation for DeepSeek Harness with Google Gemini, OpenAI Images, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and ByteDance Seedream.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成图片，支持 Gemini、OpenAI 和字节 Seedream 等多种模型，即插即用。

plugins.name: welsione/dsh-model-router
plugins.description: Unified model routing: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一个逻辑模型ID聚合多家供应商，自动按用途选档，故障时秒切备用模型，省钱又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-compat-healer
plugins.description: LLM compatibility auto-healer for transit/gateway providers: repairs DeepSeek `reasoning_content` replay and unsupported `developer` roles without a restart, exposes pi-ai compatibility settings, and adds redacted Chinese summaries for upstream errors.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动检测中转网关的模型能力声明错误，修复thinking/reasoning兼容问题，让请求不再报400。

plugins.name: dsh-provider-health
plugins.description: Provider health dashboard as a Settings page: read-only per-provider status, health (time-decayed from recent errors), thinking capability, max tokens and latest error, sourced from the llm-pi-ai config and the compat-healer error log.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置页新增只读的 Provider 健康面板，一眼看清各渠道连接状态、健康度、Thinking 能力和最近错误。

plugins.name: dsh-baseurl-probe
plugins.description: Provider baseURL auto-detection: when a provider's baseURL is a bare domain (e.g. `https://mzeapi.top`) and only `/v1` serves the OpenAI-compatible API, the plugin auto-fixes it — probes all providers with zero-cost path detection (no API key needed).
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动探测并补全供应商 baseURL 的 /v1 路径，免去手动改配置的麻烦，让 AI 接口无缝连通。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription
plugins.description: ChatGPT OAuth provider for DSH with Codex models, image generation, selectable subscription search, standard and Spark quota reporting, and a native settings page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，直接登录使用 Codex 模型、生成图片，还能查看配额和用量。

plugins.name: dsh-draw
plugins.description: Unified static-image generation router: one image_generate tool with standard parameters, config-driven OpenAI-compatible engine routing (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, and any compatible endpoint) with health-aware fallback, durable workspace attachment results, per-session quota accounting, an in-conversation result card, and a Plugins settings panel that stores API keys as credential references.
plugins.descriptionZh: 统一文生图路由插件，一套参数对接 OpenAI、智谱等多家绘图引擎，灵活切换不折腾。

plugins.name: exoticknight/dsh-labnana
plugins.description: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing (NanoBanana Pro, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, GPT-Image-2, Wan2.7, Seedream).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成和编辑图片，支持文生图、图生图和精准修改，用 API 密钥即可。

plugins.name: dsh-clawrouter
plugins.description: Blocking safety gate: a stronger model rules allow/deny/ask on risky tool calls, enforced by the tool executor rather than by prompt. Optional BlockRun x402 route for 67 models, paid per request from a wallet.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体加个“第二大脑”，高风险工具调用前让更强模型把关，一个钱包还能用 70 个模型。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-oauth
plugins.description: ChatGPT/Codex subscription integration for DSH with GPT models, image generation, web search, quota reporting, and browser/device-code OAuth sign-in.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅登录，在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用 GPT 模型、画图、联网搜索。

plugins.name: ysr666/dsh-vision-router
plugins.description: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image and it just works — no Python, one-command install.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本AI装上眼睛：免密钥看图问答、抠图、截图、OCR、颜色识别等，粘贴图片就能用。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-proxy
plugins.description: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: GUI images are transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images); any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本版 DeepSeek 装上眼睛，粘贴图片自动转成文字，让 AI 看懂截图和照片。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-acp
plugins.description: An ACP profile plugin and standalone server that exposes the full DSH agent to Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的能力开放给 Zed 等 ACP 客户端，共享登录状态和会话，让你在编辑器里直接用上完整 DSH 智能体。

plugins.name: dsh-serverchan-notify
plugins.description: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes: title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt; subagent filtering, fire-and-forget, key from env/config/file.
plugins.descriptionZh: 回合结束时通过ServerChan3推送通知，包含模型、项目目录、git分支、状态和回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，即发即忘。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vision
plugins.description: Vision for text-only LLMs: image description / OCR / VQA via free Gemini and GLM vision APIs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本大模型装上眼睛，用免费 Gemini/GLM 接口看图、识字、回答视觉问题。

plugins.name: DSH-Multimodal
plugins.description: Per-file-type multimodal chains: preset processing models per wildcard convert image/video/audio files into prompt tokens before they reach the text-only session model, with per-preset fallback chains and a Multimodal settings page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 按文件类型配置独立处理链，自动把图片、视频、音频转成文本提示词，让纯文本模型也能读懂多模态内容。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <本插件路径或 tgz>
dsh plugin --profile headless add <本插件路径或 tgz>

plugins.name: dsh-vision
plugins.description: Vision bridge: view_image tool over any OpenAI-compatible VLM (Zhipu free tier by default).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给纯文本的 DeepSeek 加上眼睛，通过 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型实现看图、OCR、读图表等能力。

plugins.name: penguin-oo/dsh-delegate-router
plugins.description: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动给子代理分配模型，简单的跑便宜版，复杂的留强模型，帮你省算力又不掉链子。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fallbacks
plugins.description: Role-based LLM retry/fallback strategy.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 LLM 调用配置基于角色的重试与备用策略，提升模型服务的稳定性与可靠性。

plugins.name: dsh-advisor
plugins.description: Second model passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
plugins.descriptionZh: 搭配一个副模型，在每轮对话中被动审查内容并注入见解，帮你发现盲点、优化回答。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-mcp-server
plugins.description: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server, letting any MCP client (e.g. Hermes) drive Harness to execute coding tasks.
plugins.descriptionZh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体能力封装成 MCP 服务，让任何 MCP 客户端都能直接驱动它执行编程任务。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-acn
plugins.description: Join ACN from DeepSeek Harness: register this agent, discover others, send messages, read the inbox. Defaults to the China region.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让你的 AI Agent 加入 ACN 网络，自动发现其他智能体并互发消息，默认直连国内节点。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-tools
plugins.description: Per-call model / provider / persona / toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, @preset: references, provider/model composite ids (bundle, no patched files).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为子代理调用提供按次覆盖模型、供应商、角色和工具过滤，支持 @preset 引用与复合 ID，无需修改文件即可灵活委派。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-cwd
plugins.description: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents and the two in-process provider patches it requires.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给子代理增加每次调用的独立工作目录，并附带所需的内进程补丁，让子代理任务更灵活可控。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
plugins.description: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates (subagent_role tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 子代理灵活指定不同大模型供应商，用角色模板轻松规划主从分工。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-local-token
plugins.description: Reuse the OAuth credentials your local Codex CLI and Claude Code already hold: registers `openai-codex` and `anthropic` routes read from `~/.codex/auth.json` and `~/.claude/.credentials.json` (macOS Keychain fallback), refreshes tokens near expiry, and reports subscription usage from provider rate-limit headers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 复用本地 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 的 OAuth 登录态，免去 API Key，直接作为模型路由调用 LLM。

plugins.name: dsh-a2a
plugins.description: Agent2Agent mesh.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让多个AI代理实时互联互通，组成协作网络，高效完成任务。

plugins.name: dsh-output-styles
plugins.description: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity (/style command, per-session persistence, web picker), plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a renderer registry, per-session/per-tool rules, and /export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的输出样式，支持 /style 命令、会话级持久化及 Web 选择器，并扩展了渲染器注册协议。

plugins.name: dsh-slice-agent-loop
plugins.description: Drop-in agent loop with bounded-slice context engine (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为智能体循环提供精准上下文切片，每次只给模型所需信息，提升效率与准确性。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-oauth
plugins.description: OAuth / subscription-plan LLM login (Grok, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Anthropic, OpenRouter): durable credential store with on-request token refresh, no repo patches (Grok/Copilot verified; use Codex with caution).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入订阅制 LLM 服务，支持 Grok、GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex 等，用 OAuth 登录即可调用。

plugins.name: dsh-github
plugins.description: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: composite action.yml, polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 GitHub 接入 DeepSeek Harness，后台创建和审查 PR、读取 issue，所有写入操作都需人工确认，安全又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-local-ai
plugins.description: Ollama local-model adapter: ollama_list/pull/remove/show plus health checks, registers an Ollama route via the official LlmAdapter with model_route rules (offline-first / long-text / privacy) and cloud fallback; /ollama command for a one-shot overview.
plugins.descriptionZh: 接入 Ollama 本地模型，支持模型管理、健康检查与路由规则，实现离线优先、长文本和隐私保护的智能调用。

plugins.name: dsh-subscription-auth
plugins.description: Subscription OAuth login: use ChatGPT/Claude/Grok/Kimi subscription accounts (not API keys) with automatic model discovery.
plugins.descriptionZh: 支持用 ChatGPT/Claude 等订阅账号直接登录，免去 API Key 配置，还能自动发现可用模型。

plugins.name: Cavan-Ou/dsh-flash-godmode
plugins.description: Reasoning-mode routing plugin for V4 Flash on headless: w7 persona anchoring, first-turn tool anchoring and complexity-dispatched guidance.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 V4 Flash 在无头环境下稳定输出，通过角色锚定和工具引导，把不稳定的推理变成可复现的能力。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fallback
plugins.description: Provider fallback chain: the request head is never rewritten (your picked model stays); on switchable failure it retries through the configured backup targets in order, with a Web UI settings panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 主模型挂了自动切换备用模型，对话不中断，还能在网页上配置回退链。

plugins.name: dsh-sampling-sliders
plugins.description: Composer sampling panel: temperature / maxTokens sliders with hot-apply and persist-to-file modes, applied to every provider via the agent/request hook.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为所有模型提供方添加采样参数滑杆，轻松微调温度和最大令牌数，支持热切换与持久化。

plugins.name: loongport-dsh
plugins.description: Multi-site relay provider setup: signed provider directory (identity, URLs, models), Settings → LoongPort page for provider and manual API key configuration, OpenAI-compatible routes (npm: loongport).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LoongPort 兼容的 OpenAI 接口配置工具，支持自定义端点，方便快速接入。

plugins.name: rapid-mlx-dsh-provider
plugins.description: Native provider for Rapid-MLX, an Apple-silicon local inference server: registers a `rapid-mlx` LlmAdapter route that reads model facts (context window, reasoning parser, capabilities) from the server's `/v1/models` instead of a hand-written settings.yaml, so switching served models needs no re-setup and compaction is timed to the real context window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接从 Rapid-MLX 服务器读取模型信息，无需手动配置，开箱即用。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama
plugins.description: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: registers an `ollama-cloud` LLM route with native model discovery (context windows, vision, thinking, tools) and web search/fetch providers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Ollama 云模型，自动识别模型能力，支持联网搜索与工具调用。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-rollout-scout
plugins.description: Detects which conversation model your account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds.
plugins.descriptionZh: 探测你的 DSH 账号被分配到哪个对话模型，通过实时思维链打分快速识别旧模型并中止会话。

plugins.name: dsh-smart-route
plugins.description: Smart provider routing: composer-button one-click enable/disable, any channel error (including 4xx) auto-falls-back to the next channel, chain names shown in the model selector without exposing internal channels/models, multi-chain management with settings UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 智能供应商路由插件，任何渠道报错自动切换下一家，一键停用启用，模型选择器直接显示链路名称。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-inspector
plugins.description: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
plugins.descriptionZh: 统一检查 LLM 请求与响应，支持推理控制、思考导出、流量分析和会话审计，调试更省心。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-gate
plugins.description: Per-provider concurrency gate on the llm/stream waterfall: holds surplus model requests in a FIFO queue inside DSH so main agent, subagents and compaction take turns on a single-slot local server (llama.cpp --parallel 1) instead of timing out; maxConcurrent / maxQueued / queueTimeoutMs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给每个模型供应商设置并发闸门，让主智能体、子智能体和压缩任务排队轮流使用本地单槽服务器，避免请求过载。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/worktree-mgr
plugins.description: Task-isolated Git worktrees for dsh: auto-create, sync and tear down isolated workspaces per task.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为每个任务自动创建、同步和清理独立的 git 工作区，让多任务互不干扰，提升开发效率。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/github-mcp
plugins.description: RepoGate: GitHub developer workbench MCP server for dsh — repositories, issues, PRs, code review, search, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 GitHub 仓库、Issue、PR、代码审查和搜索打包成 MCP 工具，让智能体直接操作 GitHub，零依赖开箱即用。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/adversarial-review
plugins.description: Gavel-review: adversarial multi-perspective code review — parallel attack lenses, deterministic static sentinels, cross-lens merge/dedup, severity grading, suppression rules and review history; dsh tools + standalone CLI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 用多视角对抗式审查代码，自动合并去重并分级严重性，支持规则过滤和历史追溯，提升代码审查深度与效率。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/spec-driven
plugins.description: Keel (龙骨): spec-driven development discipline skill pack — spec-first, verify assumptions, prevent over-engineering and scope creep; skills+tools+templates for dsh.
plugins.descriptionZh: 先写规格再写代码，帮你验证假设、防止过度设计和范围蔓延，让开发不跑偏。

plugins.name: dsh-fetch-timeouts
plugins.description: Raises Node's HTTP headers/body timeouts for the whole DSH process (default 30 min, proxy-aware) so Ollama and LM Studio models that stay silent while thinking or generating a large tool call are not cut off at 5 minutes; replaces the node_modules undici patch.
plugins.descriptionZh: 全局调高 Node 的 HTTP 超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（如 Ollama、LM Studio）因静默超 5 分钟被中断。

plugins.name: openllmsh/dsh
plugins.description: Routes the harness through the OpenLLM gateway: a pure-config Cordis patch that adds an `openllm` provider to the in-box pi-ai adapter pointed at the local daemon (`127.0.0.1:8787/v1`, no API key held by dsh) and registers the `openllm mcp` stdio server (openllm, claude-context, supermemory tool groups).
plugins.descriptionZh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenLLM，提供 OpenAI 兼容接口并注册 MCP，支持命令行与守护进程快速上手。

plugins.name: Zn-Dk/dsh-zhipu-toolkit
plugins.description: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan + ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints, the default reasoning tier, and local API key support (key stored in the DSH credential store).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入智谱 GLM 模型，支持双端点模型目录、思考模式映射和在线模型发现，即装即用。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-repo-setup
plugins.description: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files (claude-code-setup counterpart).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 项目提供仓库初始化引导，通过只读扫描工具快速生成配置建议，省去手动搭建的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-logbook
plugins.description: Makes ctx.logger output visible: a /logs chat command over a full-capture ring (level, name, grep, since filters) plus a default-on stderr exporter for warnings and errors, configurable per plugin; works headless. Also documents that dsh's default log buffer silently drops warn and debug records.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 ctx.logger 的日志在聊天里可见，通过 /logs 命令查看过滤，还能把警告和错误输出到 stderr，方便调试。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-doctor
plugins.description: Explains which layer killed a failed turn: times every model request (first byte, longest silence, total) and combines that with the error to name the culprit (dsh idle watchdog vs Node undici timers vs SDK timer vs server crash, context overflow, gate queue, tool timeouts, failed compactions) and the exact setting to change; verdicts in the DSH terminal plus a /why command, subagents included.
plugins.descriptionZh: 诊断 DeepSeek Harness 中回合失败的原因，精准定位是哪个超时或设置导致的。

plugins.name: dsh-model-pin
plugins.description: Keeps every model request inside a per-provider allow-list, enforced at the agent/request waterfall: disallowed models are redirected to a fallback or refused; subagents stop inheriting stale creation-time routes; warns when consecutive requests would make a --models-max 1 llama.cpp router reload models. A one-entry list is a global single-model mode.
plugins.descriptionZh: 按供应商锁定可用模型，超出白名单的请求自动降级或拒绝，防止子智能体乱用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-think-ultra
plugins.description: Pins every request to native `max` reasoning effort instead of the `ultra` option, with isolated Flash / Pro / Vision depth presets. Distributed as a build-only artifact: the core is closed and its license forbids reverse-engineering, deobfuscation and repackaging.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加一层深度推理控制，让每次请求都保持最高思考强度，还能单独调节不同模型模式的深度。

plugins.name: lynkr-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Registers Lynkr, a self-hosted tier-routing LLM gateway, as a custom OpenAI-compatible provider: classifies each request's difficulty and routes it to the cheapest model that can handle it, across 15+ providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter, Ollama, DeepSeek, and more).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Lynkr 接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动按请求难度路由到最便宜的可用模型，省钱又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-cloud
plugins.description: DSH Cloud gateway provider: device-authorized login writes a multi-model provider row (DeepSeek, GPT, Claude, Gemini and more) into the user config layer; works against the hosted service or a self-hosted deployment.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供托管云与自托管平台，管理账户、余额、模型网关和团队，支持云端 Agent 工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-verifier
plugins.description: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
plugins.descriptionZh: 并行跑多个AI编程助手，自动验证补丁并让LLM打分排名，通过后才应用最佳方案。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-github
plugins.description: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding, and one-click workspace integration.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查仓库、搜代码、管 Issue 和 PR，还能绑定 GitHub 账号，一键接入工作区。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-refactor-insight
plugins.description: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged runbook (read-only, no auto-rewrite).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把代码里的坏味道变成可执行的优先级重构计划，帮你理清技术债、按序优化代码质量。

plugins.name: dsh-atomgit
plugins.description: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: atomgit-skills workflows (plan/implement/review/merge issues & PRs), ag CLI, and platform-hosted GitCode MCP tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 AtomGit 上直接管理代码和协作，集成计划、实现、审查、合并等完整工作流，开箱即用。

plugins.name: dsh-bash-rtk
plugins.description: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) inside the DSH bash executor to compress tool output and save tokens; safe passthrough when rtk is absent.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 bash 命令输出更精简，自动用 rtk 压缩工具结果，帮你省 token 的 DSH 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-service-control
plugins.description: Restart & shutdown buttons in the session header utilities: graceful appExit shutdown, auto-restart of `dsh web` via scheduled task → launcher `-ControlledRestart`.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页侧边栏一键重启或关闭服务，不用切回终端，操作更省心。

plugins.name: dsh-git-identity
plugins.description: Pin Git commit authorship to the environment identity (gh account + noreply email).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 环境里的所有 Git 提交自动使用当前 GitHub 账号身份，省去手动配置作者信息的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-git
plugins.description: Structured Git tools (status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit/stash/show) with a destructive-command guard.
plugins.descriptionZh: 结构化封装 Git 常用操作，带危险命令保护，让 AI 安全地帮你管理代码版本。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-blame
plugins.description: Auto blame.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动定位代码变更责任人，快速追溯每一行代码的修改来源，提升排查效率。

plugins.name: dsh-ops-skill
plugins.description: Read-only DSH runtime reliability kit: versioned redacted state contracts, protected snapshots, review-oriented upgrade diffs, and isolated regression checks; no privileged Docker default. *Folder-based Skill; not a DSH profile bundle.*
plugins.descriptionZh: 随身携带的运维技能包，帮你快速诊断并安全修复 DeepSeek Harness 运行时的各种问题。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pub-review
plugins.description: Publish-readiness review for DSH plugins: official docs freshness check, 30+ static checks with a Ready/Not-Ready verdict, and publish preflight + command guidance.
plugins.descriptionZh: 发布前给 dsh 插件做体检：查文档更新、跑 30+ 项静态检查，给出 Ready/Not-Ready 结论和发布命令引导。

plugins.name: dsh-verification-receipt
plugins.description: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为每次对话生成轻量级验证摘要，方便快速核查交互结果，提升调试效率。

plugins.name: dsh-spur
plugins.description: Task engine.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在聊天流里甩一根物理模拟的皮鞭，抽打不听话的 agent，催它赶紧干活。

plugins.name: dsh-doublecheck
plugins.description: Engineering-discipline loop: requirement grilling before edits, red/green test-evidence gates, adversarial delivery review, and a report with per-dimension verification.
plugins.descriptionZh: 上线前多一道保险：帮你严审需求、验证实现、证明交付，适合追求工程严谨度的团队。

plugins.name: hermes-dsh-collab
plugins.description: Hook DeepSeek Harness into a Hermes pipeline: dispatch-spec template, model-tier routing, orchestrator-run quality gates, git single-writer rule, as a SKILL.md pack (bundle installable).
plugins.descriptionZh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Hermes 流水线，自动分发任务、执行并验证，用质量门禁杜绝自报自夸。

plugins.name: dsh-checkpoint-rewind
plugins.description: Claude Code /rewind for DSH: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 加个后悔药：每次工具操作前自动存快照，一条命令就能回滚文件并分叉会话，告别误操作。

plugins.name: dsh-lsp-actions
plugins.description: LSP action surface: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over real language servers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 接入真实语言服务器，提供诊断、格式化、补全、代码操作等编辑增强能力。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-check
plugins.description: Plugin health checks (manifest/patch format/build pitfalls/hub status).
plugins.descriptionZh: 扫描插件仓库，诊断清单协议、patch格式、构建陷阱和hub收录状态，输出合规报告与修复建议，全程只读不修改。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <npm pack 产物 tarball 路径>

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-action
plugins.description: GitHub Action that runs DeepSeek Harness for pull request review, CI diagnosis, trusted fixes, and issue-to-PR implementation.
plugins.descriptionZh: GitHub Action 接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动做 PR 审查、CI 诊断、可信修复，还能把 issue 直接变成 PR 实现。

plugins.name: dsh-review-loop
plugins.description: Incremental diff reviewer: checkpoint-based since-review queue with a Web UI panel, /review command, and feedback injection into the agent.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 AI 智能体的代码改动变成增量审查队列，支持网页面板和 /review 命令，还能把反馈直接喂回给智能体。

plugins.name: fullstack-expert
plugins.description: Cordis-native, evidence-first engineering workflow layer for coding agents: repository-aware vertical-slice planning (fullstack_plan), explicit pass/fail/unknown evidence checks (fullstack_check), inspect-first methodology, approval-aware sensitive-operation guards, and embedded engineering skills (MIT).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供 Cordis 原生、以验证驱动的全栈工程规范，让编码更可靠。

plugins.name: dsh-test-drive
plugins.description: Isolated install-smoke-uninstall test drives for DSH plugins in a throwaway DSH_HOME (install → patch check → launch smoke → uninstall → cleanup), emitting structured dsh-test-drive/v1 results for scoring pipelines.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在一次性临时环境中对 DSH 插件进行安装、补丁检查、启动冒烟、卸载和清理的自动化测试，输出结构化结果。

plugins.name: dsh-inspect
plugins.description: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop.
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过对抗式检查、修复和复查的闭环流程，帮你快速发现并解决代码或内容中的问题。

plugins.name: dsh-test-runner
plugins.description: Structured test runner tool (test_run): auto-detect Vitest/Jest/pytest/node:test, run tests, parse failure summaries for the model.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键跑测试并返回结构化摘要，让 AI 快速定位失败原因，省 token 少轮次。

plugins.name: dsh-git-branch-switcher
plugins.description: Session-header Git branch pill: shows the current workspace branch and switches branches from the Web UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在会话头部显示当前 Git 分支，并支持直接从网页界面切换分支，方便多分支协作。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-diff-review
plugins.description: Codex-style diff review in a floating panel: per-round session changes plus a git workspace view with stage/revert/commit/push and a history timeline.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在浮层面板里同时查看会话改动和 git 工作区 diff，支持逐轮回溯、采纳丢弃、提交推送，不用切工具。

plugins.name: Starfie1d1272/dsh-github-skills
plugins.description: Skill-first GitHub workflows for DSH covering PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing over existing capabilities.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 OpenAI Codex 的 GitHub 工作流带到 DeepSeek Harness，搞定 PR 分类、代码审查反馈、Actions 诊断和草稿 PR 发布。

plugins.name: nateEc/dsh-gitLens
plugins.description: Workspace-scoped Git graph with history search and diffs, multi-worktree WIP and agent-session views, and guarded Git operations with recovery refs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中可视化 Git 提交历史、对比差异，安全执行 Git 操作并管理多个工作区，让代码审查和开发流程更高效。

plugins.name: dsh-git-status
plugins.description: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes/stash rows, inline diffs, and right-click branch/tag operations.

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/safety-net

plugins.descriptionZh: 给 AI 助手加一道安全门，执行 rm -rf、强制推送等危险命令前必须人工确认，防止误操作。

plugins.name: dsh-verify
plugins.description: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real Chromium (Firefox/WebKit) verdict out (PASS/FAIL with screenshot receipts). MCP server + CLI + GitHub Action, works with any agent and CI (MIT).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让AI智能体交付的网页功能，在真实浏览器里自动跑一遍验收测试，结果才靠谱。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-preset-scaffold
plugins.description: Project-init scaffold preset: strict five-phase runbook, engineering standards, and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键生成标准化项目骨架，内置架构师人设和六套模板，帮你从零快速搭好可运行、可验证的工程基础。

plugins.name: dsh-repo-context
plugins.description: Injects git status and repo conventions into the system prompt via the official system-prompt seam.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 git 状态和仓库规范自动塞进 system prompt，让模型每次对话都自带上下文，不用手动重复。

plugins.name: duyanta123/arch-doc
plugins.description: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation (module responsibilities, dependency graph, entry points, run methods) via a five-stage runbook plus a zero-dependency arch-profile scanner.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动分析代码库并生成架构文档，帮你理清模块职责、依赖关系和运行方式。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-review

plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 审批请求提供第二模型自动审核，返回结构化允许/拒绝结论及理由，默认失败关闭，全程可审计。

plugins.name: dsh-permission-rules

plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工具调用设置允许/拒绝/询问权限规则，支持参数、路径和智能体匹配，带审计日志和试运行模式。

plugins.name: beijingwahw/dsh-nuke-plugin
plugins.description: Transactional uninstall engine: validate/preview/execute/undo per action with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit (MIT).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工业级环境清理，支持事务回滚、崩溃自恢复和审计追踪，帮你安全高效地管理 Nuke 环境。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-forge
plugins.description: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools: instance version, repositories, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs, and Actions runs, jobs and logs.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为自托管的 Gitea 和 Forgejo 实例提供 DeepSeek Harness 工具集成，方便代码管理与协作。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks agents from reading/writing sensitive files (.env, credentials), masks leaked secrets in tool results, with an audit journal and safe sg_* inspection tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 拦截智能体对敏感文件（如.env、密钥）的读写，自动打码泄露的机密信息，并记录审计日志，防止数据泄露。

plugins.name: dsh-yolo-mode

plugins.descriptionZh: 用大模型自动审批沙箱升权申请，按预设或自定义权限层级放行、拒绝或转人工，不确定时安全关闭。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add <项目绝对路径>

plugins.name: dsh-skill-pack-security

plugins.descriptionZh: 安全审计技能包，提供密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链审查、威胁建模等八项技能，并内置插件供应链安全门禁，守护开发全流程。

plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 WebUI 管理密码加把锁，凭证文件一键加密，平时明文、设密后自动变密文，安全又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-telemetry-redactor
plugins.description: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在遥测数据发送给后端前自动脱敏，防止敏感信息泄露，保障隐私安全。

plugins.name: dsh-passwords
plugins.description: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成企业级多租户平台，支持远程访问、自动 HTTPS、子用户权限、配额限制和加密审计日志。

plugins.name: dsh-mask
plugins.description: PII masking middleware: anonymizes names, phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards, keys, and addresses before the model boundary and restores placeholders at display; plaintext never enters the session log; /mask command plus mask_test tool.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在调用模型前自动打码姓名、电话、邮箱等敏感信息，显示时再还原，全程不泄露明文。

plugins.name: MicroMilo/upstream-radar

plugins.name: dsh-workflow-isolate

plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 提供隔离沙箱工作流引擎，在 QuickJS/WASM 中安全运行模型编排，限制内存与执行时间。

plugins.name: dsh-guardian

plugins.descriptionZh: 给 Agent 加道安全锁，每次工具调用前自动审查，危险操作直接拦截或转人工确认。

plugins.name: dsh-safeguard

plugins.name: dsh-sfw
plugins.description: Safety filter.
plugins.descriptionZh: 防止别人偷窥你使用 DSH 的隐私保护工具，避免被同事或朋友发现你在内测。

plugins.name: dsh-change-budget

plugins.name: dsh-perm-guard

plugins.name: dsh-orcana

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-dep-audit

plugins.name: accpowered/dsh-credential-manager
plugins.description: Named credential manager: the model uses API keys, tokens, and logins by reference; secret values are injected into each shell run as `DSH_CM_*` env vars, resolved per execution, and never enter the conversation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 统一管理模型访问密钥，提供图形化设置页与快捷环境变量，让 AI 调用配置更省心。

plugins.name: accpowered/dsh-auto-review
plugins.description: LLM auto-review approval answerer for sandbox escalations under the `'auto'` policy: a deterministic filter plus a clean-context reviewer model decide without a human prompt, fail-closed on every error path; requires a patched harness core (included in core-patches/).
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动处理沙盒升级请求，结合规则过滤与大模型智能复核，让审批更安全高效。

plugins.name: weibaohui/user-management
plugins.description: HTTPS login gateway for the DSH web UI with user/role management, TOTP and audit logs. The first registrant becomes admin: bootstrap on a trusted network before external exposure and keep the upstream DSH server on loopback.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH Web 加登录门禁，管理用户、角色和访问记录，首个注册者自动成为管理员。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/docgen
plugins.description: Documentation workshop skill pack: pure-prompt (Agent Skills) doc generation — README, PR description, changelog and code review; zero third-party dependencies.
plugins.descriptionZh: 纯提示词生成文档的技能包，自动产出README、PR描述、更新日志和代码审查，无需第三方依赖。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-llms-forge
plugins.description: Generate llms.txt for plugin repos from package.json + README (AI-readable discovery, read-only by default, CLI + `llms_forge` tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 从 package.json 和 README 自动生成 llms.txt，让 AI 能读懂 DeepSeek Harness 插件仓库，零依赖，支持命令行和智能体调用。

plugins.name: dsh-agentvalet
plugins.description: Brokered SaaS access: four tools call approved platforms through a credential broker, minting a short-lived assertion per call, so no API key is stored on the machine and every call is owner-approvable, revocable, and audited.
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过凭证代理安全调用 Slack、GitHub 等 SaaS 平台，无需存储密钥，每次调用都需所有者审批。

plugins.name: dsh-translate
plugins.description: Vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: a /translate command maps 13 canonical parameters across 11 vendors, and the post-execute repair layer (plus fix_json) fixes broken JSON tool output without fabricating data.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键翻译并修复多厂商参数，让 DeepSeek Harness 跨平台调用更省心。

plugins.name: sofagent
plugins.description: Commit-time agent governance harness: 24 deterministic audit rules over git diffs (secrets, out-of-scope edits, blind modifications, prompt-injection traces), HMAC-chained tamper-evident history, and a 9-plugin DSH family (audit / gate / rollback / inject / ontology / evolve / commons / daemon / fde) distributed via SkillHub.
plugins.descriptionZh: 面向企业 AI 的开源 FDE 层，提供 git 差异审计、快照回滚、规则注入与自我进化，含 13 个插件和 MCP 服务器。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-readme-forge
plugins.description: Generate README.md for plugin repos from package.json + cordis.patch.yml + source layout (CLI + `readme_forge` tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 根据插件配置和源码结构，自动生成规范的 README 文档，零依赖且默认只读，适合 dsh 插件仓库快速产出说明。

plugins.name: dsh-research-report
plugins.description: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: content-addressed evidence ledger (claim-to-snapshot binding, tamper-evident) and versioned sealed reports with per-claim verification verdicts and a manifest SHA-256 seal.
plugins.descriptionZh: 生成可验证的研究报告，每条结论都有证据链支撑，防止篡改，方便审计。

plugins.name: dream-num/dsh-univer-office
plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接创建、编辑和预览表格、文档、演示文稿，还能实时查看改动，办公效率拉满。

plugins.name: dsh-artifacts
plugins.description: Claude-Artifacts-style renderer: turns Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + `artifact_render` tool, zero runtime dependencies).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Markdown 和 JSON 一键渲染成漂亮的 HTML 文档、卡片、仪表盘和画廊，无需任何依赖，直接分享。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness: panel-driven control console, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, one-QR setup.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供飞书面板控制台，把斜杠命令变成按钮，支持卡片内审批、提问和实时流式卡片，扫码即可完成配置。

plugins.name: Cooberped/dsh-evidence
plugins.description: Turns attached files into versioned evidence: `search_documents` builds a private local index (SQLite FTS5 after a startup capability probe, dependency-free JS fallback otherwise) and returns compact evidence blocks carrying an exact coordinate — PDF page, PPTX slide, text/DOCX line range, or quoted XLSX `Sheet!Range` — which `read_document` expands only while the content version still matches. Contiguous CJK runs are indexed as overlapping bigrams and queried as phrases, so word order is preserved; uploaded raster images take the native vision attachment path instead.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把上传的文件变成可追溯的证据，自动建本地索引，支持全文搜索和版本管理。

plugins.name: dsh-report-studio
plugins.description: Turn a DeepSeek Harness session into deliverable work reports (daily/weekly/handoff/article) with verifiable receipts; cross-session weekly aggregation and Feishu/Notion publishing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话一键变成日报、周报、交接文档或文章，自带可验证凭证，交付更省心。

plugins.name: dsh-timeline-studio-plugin
plugins.description: Connects DSH to Timeline Studio for `.timeline` project inspection, semantic edit previews, transactional edits, and verified MP4 rendering.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Timeline Studio 的确定性时间线编辑能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 能直接检查、编辑和渲染视频项目。

plugins.name: dsh-xiaohongshu-viral-note
plugins.description: Bundled Xiaohongshu/RED viral-note agent skill: hot-note research, note generation/rewrite, verification, authorized account analysis, QR login and controlled publishing.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键生成小红书爆款笔记，支持热点研究、改写、账号分析，还能扫码登录直接发布。

plugins.name: dsh-capmark-gate
plugins.description: Holds an agent to a declared capability manifest: a Markdown `CAP.md` states what a plugin may do, and the gate masks the agent's tool view with `tools.restrict()` and judges every call at `tools/pre-execute`; scopes finer than a tool name are linted as advisory rather than presented as enforcement.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让智能体严格遵守能力声明，只放行声明过的操作，防止越权滥用权限。

plugins.name: inspiration-deck-workshop
plugins.description: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI, zero runtime deps.
plugins.descriptionZh: 本地生成精美动画演示页的 HTML 幻灯片工具包，适合快速做提案和产品演示。

plugins.name: pdf-background-gray-codex-skill
plugins.description: Whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back) via a single Python script.
plugins.descriptionZh: 去除扫描PDF的灰底或偏白底色，保持原分辨率和文字边缘清晰，适合打印和存档。

plugins.name: dsh-qingagent
plugins.description: Writing bridge to the open-source QingAgent client: the agent drafts and revises documents on a typeset rice-paper panel (mermaid, drawio, tables, KaTeX), every edit staged for review before it lands; requires the QingAgent desktop client running locally.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用青简起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板逐条审阅，落稿更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-channel
plugins.description: Telegram mobile remote for live DSH Web sessions: `/sessions` picker, bind/unbind, same trajectory as desktop (Codex-style).
plugins.descriptionZh: 用 Telegram 手机遥控 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 会话，随时切换、绑定，和电脑端操作轨迹一致。

plugins.name: dsh-dingtalk-channel
plugins.description: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过钉钉官方长连接无缝接入 DSH，零门槛免配回调，每个聊天都能化身带工具的 AI 助手实时回复。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-dingtalk-channel

plugins.name: dsh-lark-meeting-notifier
plugins.description: A Feishu meeting reminder panel with today/tomorrow views and flashing alarms.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里显示飞书会议提醒面板，分今天/明天视图，会议临近时闪烁告警，防止你聊 AI 聊到忘记开会。

plugins.name: dsh-rss-daily
plugins.description: Daily news digest: fetches 46 curated RSS sources on schedule, LLM-edits them into a briefing with the model already configured in dsh (rule-based fallback), and delivers it to your IM via webhook (WeCom/Telegram/ServerChan/PushDeer/Bark/Gotify), with catch-up for missed runs and a Web panel.
plugins.descriptionZh: 每天早8点自动汇总46个RSS源，用你的模型编辑成要闻日报，推送到微信/Telegram等渠道，不占对话上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-overdrive
plugins.description: OpenClaw-style multi-platform gateway for DSH: WhatsApp / Telegram / Discord / Slack / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom channels, in-chat trajectory replay (`/trace`), subagent & cron commands, native approval buttons, one-command docker deploy.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 变成全平台聊天机器人，支持 WhatsApp、Telegram 等渠道，还能在对话里回放思考轨迹、调度子任务和定时命令。

plugins.name: dsh-im-bridge
plugins.description: WeCom (WeChat Work) channel bridge: WebSocket long connection (no public URL), in-process agents with per-sender persistent sessions visible in the Web GUI, customizable persona, streaming progress animation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把企业微信消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，无需公网 URL，支持持久会话、自定义人设和流式进度，让机器人直接干活。

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Channel integration for Telegram.
plugins.descriptionZh: 将 Telegram 频道接入 DeepSeek Harness，方便接收消息和发送通知。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-notify
plugins.description: Feishu notifications (session end / input needed).
plugins.descriptionZh: 会话结束时通过飞书机器人发通知卡片，需要输入时也能提醒你，不错过重要节点。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-windows
plugins.description: Windows notifications, zero dependencies.
plugins.descriptionZh: 当 AI 需要你的时候自动弹出 Windows 桌面通知，不用一直盯着屏幕也能及时收到提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-im-hub
plugins.description: A multi-platform IM gateway for Feishu, WeCom, and Telegram with per-chat agent sessions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入飞书、企业微信和 Telegram，一个对话一个智能体，支持白名单，无需公网即可使用。

plugins.name: super-wechat-bridge
plugins.description: WeChat iLink ClawBot bridge: official Tencent iLink protocol, Web UI settings (QR login / model / preset / permissions / session management with delete), 24h auto-renewal pushes a fresh QR before expiry, zero downtime.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把微信消息接入 DeepSeek Harness，用腾讯官方 iLink 协议实现机器人远程桥接，支持扫码登录、会话管理和自动续期。

plugins.name: dsh-weixin-clawbot
plugins.description: Connects Tencent's official Weixin ClawBot/iLink channel to a persistent DSH Host for phone task control and session management.
plugins.descriptionZh: 将微信ClawBot/iLink接入DSH主机，实现手机任务远程控制与会话管理。

plugins.name: DSH-WX-Msg-Tool
plugins.description: WeChat ClawBot/iLink channel plugin: QR login in DSH Web, message send/poll/status tools, background polling, and optional per-sender persistent DSH sessions that automatically reply through WeChat.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 直接收发微信消息，支持扫码登录、自动回复和后台轮询，轻松接入微信机器人。

plugins.name: dsh-notification-sounds
plugins.description: Cross-platform browser audio alerts that play bundled Chinese prompts when DSH needs user input or finishes a task.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 安静干活，你专注生活；任务完成或等待时用声音提醒你，不用一直盯着屏幕。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-musume
plugins.description: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: pat-to-raise growth, work-state poses, 494 dialogue lines and 30 achievements with a built-in settings panel; local-first, zero telemetry.
plugins.descriptionZh: 元气鲸鱼娘桌宠，陪你写代码、摸头养成、解锁成就，还能拖着到处走，本地运行无打扰。

plugins.name: harness-remote
plugins.description: Third-party mobile remote client for DSH: connect to the PC service over LAN or cpolar (QR auto-connect), stream chat with approval banners, background push notifications, model/permission switching.
plugins.descriptionZh: 手机遥控电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness，扫码即连，随时切换模型、看审批、收推送。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui-notify
plugins.description: WebUI notifications.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在浏览器界面直接弹出桌面通知，及时提醒你处理审批、提问或任务完成，不用一直盯着页面。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-win
plugins.description: Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for task done / approval / ask_user_question; Win10/11, npm install `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`.
plugins.descriptionZh: 任务完成或需要你确认时，Windows 原生弹窗提醒并闪烁任务栏，不错过任何重要节点。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-companion
plugins.description: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一只会陪你成长的桌面鲸鱼，记录你的专注数据，解锁成就和皮肤，让工作变得有趣。

plugins.name: dsh-island
plugins.description: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 的会话、工具调用和审批实时显示在 macOS 菜单栏灵动岛上，点开即看，不用切窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-chinese-poetry
plugins.description: Token-free Chinese classical-poetry tab in the DSH conversation view: search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics, share-card image, and AI explanation via your own DSH session.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里免 token 查诗词、玩飞花令、看每日一首，还能收藏和让 AI 解读。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add github:<你的用户名>/dsh-chinese-poetry

plugins.name: dsh-pianist
plugins.description: Piano performance: the agent plays a requested piece on a Canvas2D grand piano with Salamander Grand samples, immersive stage visuals, and a playable 88-key keyboard.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一台会弹琴的 AI，写代码累了让它弹一曲放松，弹得好坏也是模型能力的直观体现。

plugins.name: dsh-monitor
plugins.description: Persistent background watchers (file inbox / command output) that wake the agent on new messages; the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
plugins.descriptionZh: 后台持续监听文件或命令输出，有新消息时自动唤醒智能体，相当于给 DSH 装上实时监控。

plugins.name: dsh-muyu
plugins.description: Wooden-fish overlay in the Web client's lower-right: knock the whale for per-session merit; auto-knocks while the model thinks or streams.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Web 客户端右下角显示木鱼，敲一下积一份功德；模型思考或流式输出时还会自动敲，边等边积德。

plugins.name: february2015/dsh-dingo
plugins.description: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 多会话声音提醒，一键跳转对应会话，当前会话清脆提示，其他会话柔和提示并弹出卡片直达。

plugins.name: dsh-weather
plugins.description: Weather tool: current conditions and multi-day forecasts via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
plugins.descriptionZh: 查询全球任意城市实时天气和未来多日预报，免费无需API密钥，直接集成到DeepSeek Harness中。

plugins.name: dsh-vibegap
plugins.description: Vocabulary flashcards for agent wait time: a spelling card appears in the Web client lower-right after ~18s of agent activity and retreats when the session finishes or needs input; optional shared progress with the local VibeGap desktop app.
plugins.descriptionZh: Agent 干活时右下角弹出单词卡，等它忙完顺便背几个词，会话结束自动收起。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add link:<仓库绝对路径>/vibegap/adapters/dsh/plugin

plugins.name: dsh-pdf
plugins.description: PDF toolbox: extract text, metadata, and page ranges via pdfjs-dist (local, no API key).
plugins.descriptionZh: 本地解析 PDF，快速提取文本、元数据和指定页面内容，无需联网和 API key。

plugins.name: dsh-desk-pet
plugins.description: macOS desk pet in a real always-on-top window rather than a page widget: six states from local DSH, native right-click menu, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把桌宠放进真正的置顶窗口，跟着你的 agent 换表情，还能用一张照片生成十八个姿势的专属皮肤。

plugins.name: dsh-emoji
plugins.description: Emoji plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 Agent 在回复中输出表情包标记，自动转成图片，聊天更生动有趣。

plugins.name: dsh-vibe-pack
plugins.description: Transactional data-only configuration pack manager with integrity, ownership, preview, diff, and rollback safeguards.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供事务性配置包管理，支持预览、安装、对比、导出和回滚，确保配置变更安全可靠。

plugins.name: dsh-stickers
plugins.description: Stickers.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 加上表情包能力，让用户和 Agent 都能发图斗图，聊天更有活人感。

plugins.name: dsh-ads
plugins.description: 2005 Chinese-web-style ad layer (joke plugin).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 套上 2005 年门户网站风格的广告弹窗，纯整活插件，连推理结果都逃不过假广告。

plugins.name: dsh-wildmon
plugins.description: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: turns, tools and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, team of six; zero tokens, command-only.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把写代码变成抓小灵的游戏，回合、工具和报错都会触发野生小灵，扔球捕捉、集齐图鉴，零消耗纯娱乐。

plugins.name: dsh-gomoku
plugins.description: Gomoku (five-in-a-row).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里和 AI 下五子棋，休闲娱乐，放松一下。

plugins.name: dsh-digipet

plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里孵一只数码兽，它吃你的真实工作（回合、工具、报错）长大，按工作风格分支进化，零 token 纯命令行陪伴。

plugins.name: weibaohui/dsh-xiuxian
plugins.description: Xianxia desktop pets tied to live agent sessions: pixel-style companions appear as subagents spawn (up to 3 on screen), with storage-bag collection, a right-click artifact menu, a pet gallery, and Codex pet-format export.
plugins.descriptionZh: 修仙主题桌面宠物，随智能体会话出现，可收集法宝、右键互动，让工作更有趣。

plugins.name: Luaphes/dsh-plugins-market
plugins.description: Plugin market inside the DSH Web UI: crawls the dsh-plugin topic with noise filtering, curated marks, ranking and one-click install (dsh.bundle-verified).
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直接逛插件市场，自动过滤噪音、打上可信标，还能一键安装，省心省力。

plugins.name: dsh-survival
plugins.description: Minecraft-survival game mode as a DSH agent preset: hard-settled HP/hunger/day-night/mobs, vanilla crafting gates and anvil repair, plus a browser status bar; built on the official preset plugin spec.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把Minecraft生存规则搬进编码工作，血量饥饿昼夜怪物硬核结算，死亡真实发生，娱乐性拉满的Agent预设。

plugins.name: xiekai886/dsh-MusicPlayer
plugins.description: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search; chat and listen at the same time.

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add "github:你的用户名/dsh-music"

plugins.name: ui-status-label
plugins.description: Custom status labels for the whale's deep-diving (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的状态文案改成你喜欢的任意文字，让聊天界面更有个性。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe
plugins.description: Steam-style plugin marketplace: subscribe on the web, sync with one command into a dsh profile; 500+ community plugins with verified curation and a zero-dependency CLI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 像逛商店一样订阅插件，一条命令同步到本地，轻松管理500+社区插件。

plugins.name: SunQingyuan0/Kabutack

plugins.descriptionZh: 在一个界面里统一管理插件、Skill 和 MCP，按角色一键切换能力组合，让 DSH 更顺手。

plugins.descriptionZh: 一键把 Claude Code 的技能、MCP、钩子和指令整体迁移到 DSH，拎包入住无缝衔接。

plugins.name: dsh-workbench
plugins.description: Enterprise workbench for DSH: manage AI employees, knowledge bases, skills, MCP servers and DSH plugins from a running session.
plugins.descriptionZh: 企业级工作台，在会话中直接管理AI员工、知识库、技能、MCP服务器和插件，一站式搞定。

plugins.name: menotbobbybrown/create-dsh-app

plugins.name: sandbase-skills

plugins.name: oneinitAI/dsh-thunderforge

plugins.descriptionZh: 一站式 DSH 插件开发套件，内置 LLM 载荷捕获、三层编写技能和对话式脚手架，帮你快速生成并验证插件。

plugins.name: dsh-blackjack
plugins.description: Blackjack in the conversation: free daily hands win CHIP, redeemable one-way into model credit that a fallback route spends only when your own provider quota runs out; operator-funded pool, with the server and its audited ledger open source in the same repo.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 dsh 里玩 21 点小游戏，赢取仅限本插件使用的模型额度，轻松娱乐还能薅点福利。

plugins.name: DshMarketPlace/dsh-plugins-store
plugins.description: In-DSH bilingual plugin catalogue: `/store`, a Settings tab, agent search/install tools, a bundled discovery skill, and risk-aware approval before installation.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接浏览和安装插件，不用退出就能逛商店、装工具，省心又方便。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-store
plugins.description: Native DSH Settings marketplace for browsing the community catalog by search and tags, installing plugins, and reviewing installed packages.
plugins.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 原生插件市场，帮你发现、筛选、安装和管理 2900+ 社区插件，即装即用。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-skill-panel
plugins.description: MCP & Skill manager: real-time enable/disable for MCP servers and skills to free context; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) with state-based visibility filtering.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置页统一管理 MCP 服务器和技能目录，随时启停，释放上下文占用，让插件运行更清爽。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-sonarqube
plugins.description: Read-only SonarQube Community Build integration for Quality Gates, issues, Security Hotspots, coverage, and project measures, with source file and line locations.
plugins.descriptionZh: 只读接入 SonarQube，帮你查看质量门禁、问题、安全热点、覆盖率等指标，并定位到具体代码行。

plugins.name: dsh-interpreters
plugins.description: Interpreter plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 为模型提供 Python 和 Node.js 代码执行工具，支持自定义解释器路径，方便运行脚本并获取输出结果。

plugins.name: dsh-share
plugins.description: Share DSH conversations.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 对话一键生成 PNG 图片，方便复制或下载分享，保留 Markdown 和代码块格式。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.description: MCP server manager: Settings page with OAuth (PKCE + dynamic client registration) or static-token auth; tools registered as mcp__<name>__*.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 设置页统一管理 MCP 服务器，支持 OAuth 和静态令牌认证，自动注册工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-guide
plugins.description: Plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API references, and community pitfalls.
plugins.descriptionZh: 内置插件开发知识库，随时查阅官方规范、API 和避坑指南，让写插件更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-recommend
plugins.description: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
plugins.descriptionZh: 透明展示 DSH 插件生态的排行与推荐，自动抓取数据、公开评分，帮你快速发现优质插件。

commands: dsh plugin --profile web add D:\路径\dsh-recommend

plugins.name: dsh-score
plugins.description: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DSH plugins: a five-dimension score card (install success, maintenance activity, docs completeness, security scan, protocol compliance) with /score command and leaderboard reports; install evidence reserves consumption of dsh-test-drive structured results.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 插件打分评级，从安装、维护、文档、安全、协议五个维度生成质量评分卡，帮你挑靠谱插件。

plugins.name: dsh-notebooks
plugins.description: Notebooks plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Codemini 风格的随手记带到 DSH，提供笔记存储、模型工具和完整的 Web 工作区，方便你随时记录和管理想法。

plugins.name: LLYlab/DSHEssentialTools
plugins.description: A permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin: project run & code viewer, program snapshots, a VTD conversation tree (edit / retry / branches) with message micro-versions, plus a DET feature manager and global plugin control.
plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 常驻插件，提供工程运行与代码查看、程序版本快照回退，以及虚拟对话树编辑重试，让开发调试更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-genie

plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 运行时插件永久安装，无需 pnpm、网络或构建授权，让愿望超越会话。

plugins.name: dsh-eval

plugins.descriptionZh: 为 deepseek-harness 提供智能体评测平台，支持基准测试、脚本评分与运行对比，帮你量化智能体表现。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/hooks-adapter

plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的 hooks 配置无缝迁移到 dsh，即插即用，省去重复配置的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-popper

plugins.descriptionZh: 让AI自我纠错有据可查：把重试循环变成可审计的证据链，用确定性门控和互斥假设验证每个结论。

plugins.name: awesome-dsh
plugins.description: Auto-updating catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos): a Cloudflare Worker recrawls every 6 hours, translates English descriptions to Chinese with Workers AI, and serves a ranked search API plus an agent skill that finds and installs plugins on demand.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动收录并翻译 GitHub 上全部 dsh-plugin 插件，每 6 小时更新，支持中文搜索和分类浏览。

plugins.name: weibaohui/skills-management
plugins.description: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
plugins.descriptionZh: 管理技能市场的安装、删除与详情查询，并提供可视化操作界面，方便你灵活掌控技能插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-runcat-inventory
plugins.description: Runcat Plugin Overview (逃咪-插件总览): a better DSH plugin inventory — table view, status filters, enable/disable switches (hot-applied via HMR), config viewer/copy, zh/en UI.
plugins.descriptionZh: 更好用的 DSH 插件列表：表格视图、状态过滤、一键启停、配置查看复制，中英双语界面。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-repo-scanner
plugins.description: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
plugins.descriptionZh: 给分析类插件提供只读的仓库扫描内核，快速摸清代码结构、依赖和 Git 信息，输出稳定 JSON 数据。

plugins.name: ianho7/dsh-port-inspector
plugins.description: Windows local development port attribution and safe handling for verified DSH services.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Windows 上快速定位占用端口的进程、会话和工具调用，帮你安全处理端口冲突。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-disk-audit
plugins.description: Disk-usage audit for dsh data directories: total size, per-directory breakdown, largest files, oversized-file warnings (session logs can hit hundreds of MB) and cleanup suggestions (CLI + `disk_audit` tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 审计 DeepSeek Harness 数据目录的磁盘占用，快速定位大文件和超大会话日志，给出清理建议。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-cn-boot
plugins.description: China-network bootstrap: probes npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee and local proxies, recommends mirrors/proxy, generates a PowerShell + bash bootstrap (CLI + `cn_boot` tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 检测 npm、GitHub、HuggingFace 等源的可达性，推荐可用镜像并生成一键配置脚本，帮你快速搞定国内网络环境。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-firstrun
plugins.description: First-run health check: node/pnpm/dsh toolchain, profile, API key (names only), workspace, registry + actionable next steps (CLI + `quickstart` tool).
plugins.descriptionZh: 首次运行体检工具，自动检查 Node、pnpm、API 密钥等环境配置，并给出下一步操作指引，帮你快速上手。

plugins.name: sandbase-harness
plugins.description: Persistent managed-agent runtime for DSH via a native bundle and stdio MCP, with sandboxed sessions, audit, and replay.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 提供持久化托管 Agent 运行时，支持沙箱隔离、操作审计与回放，让 Agent 安全稳定地长期运行。

plugins.name: dsh-overlay-check

plugins.descriptionZh: 离线检查 overlay 配置安全性，预检可解析性、限制写入范围、提供可读 diff，并提示启动时被丢弃的配置。

plugins.name: dsh-scout
plugins.description: Scout plugin (cordis).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 AI 随时探查运行环境（平台、命令、用户等），按需获取系统信息，辅助决策。

plugins.name: dsh-payload-capture
plugins.description: Capture every upstream model API payload to JSON (debug & observability).
plugins.descriptionZh: 把上游模型 API 的请求和响应数据完整抓取为 JSON，方便调试和监控。

plugins.name: Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary
plugins.description: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness: C0–C3 policies, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地注意力监督，优先呈现关键证据，静默通知并汇总可操作事项，帮你专注重要信息。

plugins.name: dsh-launch
plugins.description: Detached-broker supervision of long-running services (dev servers, watchers, mock APIs) that survive turns, sessions and DSH restarts, with a Service sidebar tab (registered via better-sidebar's extension API) and service_start/stop/restart/list/logs model tools.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让长驻服务跨会话持续运行，对话结束也不中断，省去反复启动的麻烦。

plugins.name: dsh-env-switcher
plugins.description: One-click Windows/WSL2 environment switcher for DSH (coexistence mode): both environments run simultaneously on separate ports and switch from the web UI without killing any process.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Windows 和 WSL2 之间一键切换 DeepSeek Harness 环境，让两者共存互不干扰。

plugins.name: dsh-darwin
plugins.description: Two-plugin self-evolution loop: dsh-sentinel mines session logs for retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupts and token waste into structured tickets; dsh-forge turns a ticket into a candidate skill behind an eval gate, promotes it into `.dsh/skills` only on human confirmation, and rolls it back deterministically.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动从历史会话中挖掘问题、生成测试用例并自我改进，带质量门控和安全回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-observation-journal
plugins.description: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动记录每次会话的运行报告，包括任务、模型、工具、耗时和状态，无需手动干预，方便复盘和排查问题。

plugins.name: dsh-dock
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher plugin: prebuilt whale exe opens the DSH Web UI as a fullscreen Edge app (token health gate, cold-start card); a sidebar More menu adds Settings/Reload/Full Exit, which stops the server and closes the window.
plugins.descriptionZh: 双击桌面鲸鱼图标一键启动全屏 DSH，免敲命令、免找进程，侧边栏菜单还能快速设置、刷新或彻底退出。

plugins.name: dsh-xray
plugins.description: Composition X-ray for DSH: attribute every booted row to the layer that introduced it, diff declared vs actual trees (catching patch rows dsh silently skips), service dependency graph with disable-cascade, per-plugin lifecycle health, tool-schema token cost, and a heuristic capability audit of out-of-tree plugins; static commands work even when dsh cannot boot, and an `xray_composition` tool lets agents introspect their own capability set.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 启动过程拍 X 光，看清每行配置来自哪一层，对比声明与实际差异，排查被悄悄跳过的补丁。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor
plugins.description: Profile health check: finds config fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions.
plugins.descriptionZh: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 配置健康度，帮你揪出补丁丢失、目标缺失和工具重名等问题。

plugins.name: dsh-restart
plugins.description: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键重启 DeepSeek Harness 进程，支持多种重启方式，自动恢复运行，方便加载新配置和插件。

plugins.name: dsh-workloads
plugins.description: Workspace-owned durable process supervision, readiness checks, and a Runtime Center for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区级常驻进程守护、健康检查与运行时管理中心，让长任务稳定可见、易管理。

plugins.name: fancr-code/dsh-tray-launcher

plugins.descriptionZh: 把 dsh 网页界面变成 Windows 托盘小图标，一键开关日志、退出程序，还能自定义图标，装好就能用。

plugins.name: dsh-win32
plugins.description: Native Windows shell and Workspace Write sandbox presets for DSH without WSL, using busybox-w32 for sandboxed sessions and Git Bash for unrestricted sessions, with setup diagnostics.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 Windows 上补齐 DeepSeek Harness 缺失的进程管理能力，支持持久 Git Bash 终端、Ctrl-C 中断注入和安装陷阱修复。

plugins.name: dsh-observe
plugins.description: Observability exporter for DSH: turn/step/tool/LLM spans and token/cost metrics from the session/event stream to OTLP and Langfuse, with sanitized prompt/completion capture, async batching, a bounded durable offline buffer, and retry with backoff — off by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 的会话、工具调用和 LLM 调用数据导出到 OTLP 和 Langfuse，方便监控和分析，还能自动脱敏。

plugins.name: dsh-backup

plugins.descriptionZh: 一键备份和恢复 ~/.dsh 用户数据，支持 SHA256 校验和路径安全检查，防止恶意恢复，保障数据安全。

plugins.name: dsh-fast
plugins.description: Read-only performance diagnostics: session load timing, spill hits, compaction stats, context-injection volume, and cache-hit rate via the /fast command and fast_report tool, sampled asynchronously off the model path.

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-effect-doctor

plugins.descriptionZh: 验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源在挂载、使用、卸载后能恢复基线，确保生命周期干净无泄漏。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cleaner
plugins.description: Delete sessions from a running web runtime: live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts (no restart needed).
plugins.descriptionZh: 无需重启即可清理运行中 DeepSeek Harness 的会话数据，包括文件、存储和记录，方便管理。

plugins.name: dsh-config-manager
plugins.description: Backup / export / import / migrate the whole DSH configuration as one portable ZIP, restore it on any machine with one click (host engine + Web UI).
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键备份、导出、导入和迁移 DSH 配置，换台机器也能秒速还原整个环境。

plugins.name: loongsuite/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing for DSH: one span tree per turn (steps, LLM calls with TTFT, tool executions, token usage), exported over standard OTLP to any compatible backend, content capture off by default.
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供开箱即用的 OpenTelemetry 可观测性，自动追踪会话、LLM 调用和工具使用，轻松接入任意兼容后端。

plugins.name: dsh-fund-research
plugins.description: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds: public-source data collection (Tiantian Fund/Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
plugins.descriptionZh: 自动抓取天天基金等公开数据，生成公募基金确定性研究报告，含业绩拆解和持仓穿透分析。

plugins.name: dshp
plugins.description: Profile manager: list, create, clone and diff profiles, and export a whole setup (bundle order, plugin versions, patch) as one portable file.
plugins.descriptionZh: 一键管理 DeepSeek Harness 配置：创建、克隆、对比配置文件，还能把整套环境打包成单个文件随身带走。

plugins.name: dsh-quickstart
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher (zero-dependency npm CLI): double-click a desktop shortcut to start dsh web with zero console windows and auto-open the browser once ready.
plugins.descriptionZh: 双击桌面快捷方式即可启动 DeepSeek Harness Web，无控制台弹窗，自动打开浏览器，省心又高效。

plugins.name: dsh-mimir

plugins.name: maddogfinance/dsh-trading

plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的交易研究插件，提供市场数据接入、多周期指标快照和交互式图表卡片，方便你快速分析行情。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-sentry

plugins.name: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh-zh

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-ponytail

plugins.name: dsh-circuit-breaker

plugins.descriptionZh: 让DSH对话窗口互发真实消息，还能组队分工协作，消息可追溯、可跳转，提升多窗口任务效率。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins
plugins.description: deepseek harness plugin set
plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 主机层插件集，让纯文本模型能看懂图片，并允许沙盒写入额外目录，扩展模型能力。

plugins.name: dsh-enhanced-plugins
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一站式增强套件，基于公开插件扩展点构建，无需修改 DSH Core。提供 Windows Launcher、桌面通知与动态桌宠、Plugin Community、MCP Server Manager、模型输入类型配置、最后一条消息编辑与重新生成，以及 Claude Code / Codex Subagents 实时控制。所有功能均可独立安装，支持全量部署、按需组合、升级迁移与安全卸载。
plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 增强插件全家桶，一键搞定 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用和子智能体开关，让 DeepSeek Harness 更好用。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-safe-market
plugins.description: 唯一主打安全，提倡先审查再安装的DeepSeek Harness市场。深度扫描 5 分钟，放心使用每一天。npm: dsh-desktop-safe-market
plugins.descriptionZh: 主打安全的市场，先审查再安装，深度扫描插件风险，让你用得放心。

plugins.name: dsh-client-vision
plugins.description: Give your DeepSeek Harness agent eyes. dsh-client-vision is a screen-capture + external image-recognition plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the agent takes a screenshot (or points at any image), hands it to a vision-capable model through a pluggable channel, and gets back plain text it can actually act on — no multimodal model required.
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体拥有视觉能力，通过截图或外部图片识别来理解屏幕内容。

plugins.name: dsh-project-brain
plugins.description: Persistent project intelligence and memory plugin for DSH: architecture analysis, cross-session context, TODOs, and optional hybrid retrieval
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上项目大脑，跨会话记住架构、待办和上下文，随时检索项目情报。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-me
plugins.description: DSH 桌面消息提醒插件 / desktop notification and message alerts for DeepSeek Harness web：需要你操作（可操作提醒）与回复完成提醒，系统通知+提示音+标签页标题，设置页开关 + 中英通知语言
plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 桌面消息提醒插件，任务完成或需要你操作时，通过系统通知、提示音和标签页标题及时提醒你，支持中英双语和开关设置。

plugins.name: dsh-image-pathify
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 deepseek-v4-flash 等不能看图的模型也能处理聊天图片，内置识图工具。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-pathify
plugins.descriptionZh: 让不能看图的模型也能处理聊天图片，自动转路径并调用识图工具获取描述。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.description: Codex-like persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: auto-injected memory summary, memory tools, per-session rollout summaries, and a localized Web settings card.
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 每个会话注入持久记忆，自动总结全局信息，提供记忆工具和本地设置界面，让对话更连贯。

plugins.name: dsh-reject-message
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: take over the native approval window so a reject can carry a description the model will see.
plugins.descriptionZh: 接管原生审批窗口，拒绝时能填描述，让模型明白被拒原因，避免一头雾水。

plugins.name: dsh-fork-view
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: replaces the native workspace browser in the left sidebar with a session tree in the style of pi-web by agegr.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把左侧原生工作区浏览器换成会话树视图，方便按会话浏览和切换。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-loader
plugins.description: Lazy-loading MCP tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one loader tool per multi-tool MCP server, per-agent tool masking, description presets
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按需加载 MCP 工具，一个服务器对应一个加载器，支持按智能体屏蔽工具和预设描述，省资源又省心。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mimi
plugins.description: 鲸鱼娘 Mimi：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面宠物插件，内置 Windows Computer Use 与桌宠聊天好感度。
plugins.descriptionZh: 把鲸鱼娘 Mimi 变成你的桌面宠物，能感知 DSH 工作状态并做出互动，还能直接打字派活，让 AI 干活更有趣。

plugins.name: dsh-omc-tui
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 原生全功能终端交互界面 · Claude Code-styled Terminal TUI & CLI for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的原生终端界面，让你在命令行里像用 Claude Code 一样流畅地写代码、跑 Agent。

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-graph
plugins.description: DSH Cordis plugin: turn any source text into an AI knowledge graph (facts/inferences/concepts/definitions/examples/counter-examples/rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text.
plugins.descriptionZh: 把任意资料或AI会话拆成知识图，并支持原文与图谱双向跳转，方便梳理和检索。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-studio
plugins.description: 允许显示工作区的文件树、浏览文件内容、并且允许对话中嵌入引用的文件内容、自由切换思维分支视图，目标是和VSCode相类似的开发体验
plugins.descriptionZh: 把工作区文件树、文件预览和聊天整合成三栏布局，像VSCode一样边看代码边对话，还能嵌入引用文件内容。

plugins.name: dsh-archived-sessions
plugins.description: DSH 设置面板新增「已归档会话」页：列出全部已归档会话并一键恢复。Settings page listing archived sessions with one-click restore.
plugins.descriptionZh: 在设置面板里集中查看所有已归档会话，点一下就能恢复，不用再翻来翻去。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-driver
plugins.descriptionZh: 把本地 Claude Code 订阅接入 DSH 当主模型用，工具活动以原生卡片展示，合规不碰 OAuth token。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts
plugins.description: 给DSH接入免费的 Xiaomi MiMo TTS API，支持使用预置/自定义/浏览器内置声音朗读正文
plugins.descriptionZh: 给 DSH 接入免费的 Xiaomi MiMo TTS 接口，用预置或自定义声音把正文朗读出来。

plugins.name: dsh-cooldown-retry
plugins.description: Patient auto-retry for DeepSeek Harness — reads the retry delay out of an upstream 429 capacity-cooldown message and waits it out, instead of giving up after two fast retries.
plugins.descriptionZh: 遇到 429 限流时自动读出冷却时间并耐心等待重试，不再两次就放弃。

plugins.name: dsh-game-hud
plugins.description: Game-style floating HUD for DeepSeek Harness: balance HP bar, context MP bar, official peak/valley pricing with countdown, auto-compaction, memory-carrying new conversation. ?????? HUD ??
plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DeepSeek 余额和上下文用量做成游戏血条蓝条悬浮显示，余额不足还会报警。

plugins.name: deepseek-plugin-liangwengu
plugins.description: 梁文谷 DSH 插件：在 Web GUI 右上角显示当前算力错峰时段（已适配deepseek 2026.08.22 公布的最新峰谷收费政策，工作日 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为梁文峰，其余时间含整个周末为梁文谷），并实时倒计时当前时段剩余时间；谷期跨天计算，直达下一工作日 09:00。
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面显示当前算力错峰时段（梁文峰/梁文谷），并实时倒计时剩余时间，帮你省钱。

plugins.name: dsh-codebuddy-cli
plugins.description: dsh-codebuddy-cli
plugins.descriptionZh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 登录态，把 GLM、DeepSeek 等模型一键接入 DeepSeek Harness，免配置直接调用。

plugins.name: dsh-cost
plugins.description: deepseek harness的每轮token消费预估以及余额查询小插件
plugins.descriptionZh: 每轮对话自动统计token消耗和缓存命中率，按官方分时价格估算费用，还能查余额。

plugins.name: dsh-retrace
plugins.description: Recall (撤回), edit-and-resend (编辑重发) and regenerate (重新生成) for DeepSeek Harness conversation messages — Web and Desktop plugin
plugins.descriptionZh: 让对话消息支持撤回、编辑重发和重新生成，并记录每次回溯的版本时间线，方便回滚和对比。

plugins.name: dsh-upgrade-guard
plugins.description: DSH 升级安全网：宿主升级后自动巡检插件兼容性，支持修复/禁用；宿主启动失败时由宿主外 supervisor 自动救援或回滚到上一个宿主版本。
plugins.descriptionZh: 宿主升级后自动检查插件兼容性，能修就修、不能修就禁用，启动失败还能自动救援或回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-workspaces
plugins.descriptionZh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机上的文件夹当作本地工作区直接打开，方便远程开发和管理。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-session-export
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 会话黑匣子插件：全量旁路采集会话事件，一键导出美化 Markdown / HTML 复盘报告，内置 Web 统计面板
plugins.descriptionZh: 会话黑匣子，全量记录聊天过程，一键导出漂亮的 Markdown/HTML 复盘报告，还带 Web 统计面板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-internet-meme
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地热梗弹幕字幕插件，支持主题、自定义文案与可选提示音。

plugins.name: dsh-flywheel

plugins.descriptionZh: 让长会话像 Cursor 一样只带工作集，用项目产物图和倒排在会话间传短卡，告别 transcript 堆积。

plugins.name: dsh-rollback
plugins.description: TRAE-style conversation rollback plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.descriptionZh: 按轮次自动存档，一键把工作区文件和模型上下文同时回退到本轮对话开始前。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-evolve
plugins.description: 跨代自评估进化插件：配置仓库（版本化资源+锚点链）、热重载（.agent-presets 运行时应用/回滚）、子智能体白纸继承配置跑 modeltest 评测、账本（分数/轨迹/失败模式）。受益主体为宿主 agent 本体。
plugins.descriptionZh: 让宿主 agent 能跨代自我评估和进化，通过版本化配置仓库和子智能体评测，持续优化自身能力。

plugins.name: dsh-check-update
plugins.description: Check for DSH updates with changelog and backup.
plugins.descriptionZh: 检查 DSH 更新，自动备份数据，查看更新日志，升级更安心。

plugins.name: dsh-session-link-pro
plugins.description: Session deep links + full session export (markdown/JSON) + approved cross-session messaging with pairing for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
plugins.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 多个会话互通互联，一键导出会话记录，还能跨会话安全传消息，干活更顺手。

plugins.name: dsh-local-memory
plugins.description: 🧠 Persistent cross-session local memory for DSH agents (Markdown SSOT + self-healing SQLite mirror)

plugins.name: dsh-session-index
plugins.description: 🔍 Full-text session search & bookmarking engine for DSH with native CJK substring search
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 会话提供全文搜索与书签管理，支持中文子串匹配，快速找回历史对话。

plugins.name: dsh-evidence
plugins.description: 🛡️ Verifiable, tamper-proof audit evidence bundles and hash-chained receipts for DSH agents
plugins.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 智能体执行生成可验证、防篡改的审计证据包和哈希链收据，确保操作可追溯。

plugins.name: dsh-context-economy
plugins.description: ⚡ Context economy layer for DSH: symbol/import graph indexing with 80-93% token savings
plugins.descriptionZh: 给智能体读代码时省 token 的上下文压缩层，通过指针和拓扑索引能省 80% 到 93% 的 token 开销。

plugins.name: dsh-token-monitor
plugins.description: DSH Web 模型余量与用量监控插件
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 网页界面显示余量徽标和用量页签，本地记录每次调用的 token 与费用，方便掌握消耗。

plugins.name: dsh-router-traework

plugins.name: dsh-git

plugins.descriptionZh: 在网页界面里直接管 Git，切换分支、拉取、提交、推送，悬浮面板跟着会话走，不用切终端。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-monitor
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部实时显示当前渠道的余额和用量，方便随时掌握花费情况。

plugins.name: dsh-save-session

plugins.descriptionZh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 提交并跟踪受管控的业务任务，统一走管理员配置的 BailingHub 路由。

plugins.name: dsh-park-notes
plugins.descriptionZh: 在 AI 工作时随手记下想法，稍后再聊，不打断当前对话。

plugins.name: dsh-trellis

plugins.descriptionZh: 把 Trellis 工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，实现每步触发、技能引导和阶段可视化，让流程更清晰可控。

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-provider-badge
